options.name: activeDirectory
options.description: The current setting for Active Directory. Only valid if splashPage is 'Password-protected with Active Directory'.

options.name: adaptivePolicyGroupId
options.description: Adaptive policy group ID this SSID is assigned to.

options.name: adultContentFilteringEnabled
options.description: Boolean indicating whether or not adult content will be blocked.

options.name: apTagsAndVlanIds
options.description: The list of tags and VLAN IDs used for VLAN tagging. This param is only valid when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Bridge mode' or 'Layer 3 roaming'.

options.name: authMode
options.description: The association control method for the SSID ('open', 'open-enhanced', 'psk', 'open-with-radius', 'open-enhanced-with-radius', 'open-with-nac', '8021x-meraki', '8021x-nac', '8021x-radius', '8021x-google', '8021x-entra', '8021x-localradius', 'ipsk-with-radius', 'ipsk-without-radius', 'ipsk-with-nac' or 'ipsk-with-radius-easy-psk').

options.name: availabilityTags
options.description: Accepts a list of tags for this SSID. If availableOnAllAps is false, then the SSID will only be broadcast by APs with tags matching any of the tags in this list.

options.name: availableOnAllAps
options.description: Boolean indicating whether all APs should broadcast the SSID or if it should be restricted to APs matching any availability tags. Can only be false if the SSID has availability tags.

options.name: bandSelection
options.description: The client-serving radio frequencies of this SSID in the default indoor RF profile. ('Dual band operation', '5 GHz band only' or 'Dual band operation with Band Steering').

options.name: concentratorNetworkId
options.description: The concentrator to use when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Layer 3 roaming with a concentrator' or 'VPN'.

options.name: defaultVlanId
options.description: The default VLAN ID used for 'all other APs'. This param is only valid when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Bridge mode' or 'Layer 3 roaming'.

options.name: disassociateClientsOnVpnFailover
options.description: Disassociate clients when 'VPN' concentrator failover occurs in order to trigger clients to re-associate and generate new DHCP requests. This param is only valid if ipAssignmentMode is 'VPN'.

options.name: dnsRewrite
options.description: DNS servers rewrite settings.

options.name: dot11r
options.description: The current setting for 802.11r.

options.name: dot11w
options.description: The current setting for Protected Management Frames (802.11w).

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether or not the SSID is enabled.

options.name: encryptionMode
options.description: The psk encryption mode for the SSID ('wep' or 'wpa'). This param is only valid if the authMode is 'psk'.

options.name: enterpriseAdminAccess
options.description: Whether or not an SSID is accessible by 'enterprise' administrators ('access disabled' or 'access enabled').

options.name: gre
options.description: Ethernet over GRE settings.

options.name: ipAssignmentMode
options.description: The client IP assignment mode ('NAT mode', 'Bridge mode', 'Layer 3 roaming', 'Ethernet over GRE', 'Layer 3 roaming with a concentrator', 'VPN' or 'Campus Gateway').

options.name: lanIsolationEnabled
options.description: Boolean indicating whether Layer 2 LAN isolation should be enabled or disabled. Only configurable when ipAssignmentMode is 'Bridge mode'.

options.name: ldap
options.description: The current setting for LDAP. Only valid if splashPage is 'Password-protected with LDAP'.

options.name: localAuthFallback
options.description: The current configuration for Local Authentication Fallback. Enables the Access Point (AP) to store client authentication data for a specified duration that can be adjusted as needed.

options.name: localRadius
options.description: The current setting for Local Authentication, a built-in RADIUS server on the access point. Only valid if authMode is '8021x-localradius'.

options.name: mandatoryDhcpEnabled
options.description: If true, Mandatory DHCP will enforce that clients connecting to this SSID must use the IP address assigned by the DHCP server. Clients who use a static IP address won't be able to associate.

options.name: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time
options.displayName: Meraki Action Batch Retry Wait Time
options.description: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time (integer), action batch concurrency error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_api_key
options.description: meraki_api_key (string), API key generated in dashboard; can also be set as an environment variable MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY

options.name: meraki_base_url
options.description: meraki_base_url (string), preceding all endpoint resources

options.name: meraki_be_geo_id
options.description: meraki_be_geo_id (string), optional partner identifier for API usage tracking; can also be set as an environment variable BE_GEO_ID

options.name: meraki_certificate_path
options.description: meraki_certificate_path (string), path for TLS/SSL certificate verification if behind local proxy

options.name: meraki_inherit_logging_config
options.description: meraki_inherit_logging_config (boolean), Inherits your own logger instance

options.name: meraki_log_file_prefix
options.description: meraki_log_file_prefix (string), log file name appended with date and timestamp

options.name: meraki_log_path
options.description: log_path (string), path to output log; by default, working directory of script if not specified

options.name: meraki_maximum_retries
options.description: meraki_maximum_retries (integer), retry up to this many times when encountering 429s or other server-side errors

options.name: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time
options.description: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time (integer), Nginx 429 retry wait time

options.name: meraki_output_log
options.description: meraki_output_log (boolean), create an output log file?

options.name: meraki_print_console
options.description: meraki_print_console (boolean), print logging output to console?

options.name: meraki_requests_proxy
options.description: meraki_requests_proxy (string), proxy server and port, if needed, for HTTPS

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error (boolean), retry if encountering other 4XX error (besides 429)?

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time (integer), other 4XX error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_simulate
options.description: meraki_simulate (boolean), simulate POST/PUT/DELETE calls to prevent changes?

options.name: meraki_single_request_timeout
options.description: meraki_single_request_timeout (integer), maximum number of seconds for each API call

options.name: meraki_suppress_logging
options.description: meraki_suppress_logging (boolean), disable all logging? you're on your own then!

options.name: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages
options.displayName: Meraki Use Iterator For Get Pages
options.description: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages (boolean), list* methods will return an iterator with each object instead of a complete list with all items

options.name: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit (boolean), retry if 429 rate limit error encountered?

options.name: minBitrate
options.description: The minimum bitrate in Mbps of this SSID in the default indoor RF profile. ('1', '2', '5.5', '6', '9', '11', '12', '18', '24', '36', '48' or '54').

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the SSID.

options.name: namedVlans
options.description: Named VLAN settings.

options.name: networkId
options.description: NetworkId path parameter. Network ID.

options.name: number
options.description: Number path parameter.

options.name: oauth
options.description: The OAuth settings of this SSID. Only valid if splashPage is 'Google OAuth'.

options.name: perClientBandwidthLimitDown
options.description: The download bandwidth limit in Kbps. (0 represents no limit.).

options.name: perClientBandwidthLimitUp
options.description: The upload bandwidth limit in Kbps. (0 represents no limit.).

options.name: perSsidBandwidthLimitDown
options.description: The total download bandwidth limit in Kbps. (0 represents no limit.).

options.name: perSsidBandwidthLimitUp
options.description: The total upload bandwidth limit in Kbps. (0 represents no limit.).

options.name: psk
options.description: The passkey for the SSID. This param is only valid if the authMode is 'psk'.

options.name: radiusAccountingEnabled
options.description: Whether or not RADIUS accounting is enabled. This param is only valid if the authMode is 'open-with-radius', '8021x-radius' or 'ipsk-with-radius'.

options.name: radiusAccountingInterimInterval
options.description: The interval (in seconds) in which accounting information is updated and sent to the RADIUS accounting server.

options.name: radiusAccountingServers
options.description: The RADIUS accounting 802.1X servers to be used for authentication. This param is only valid if the authMode is 'open-with-radius', '8021x-radius' or 'ipsk-with-radius' and radiusAccountingEnabled is 'true'.

options.name: radiusAccountingStartDelay
options.description: The delay (in seconds) before sending the first RADIUS accounting start message. Must be between 0 and 60 seconds.

options.name: radiusAttributeForGroupPolicies
options.description: Specify the RADIUS attribute used to look up group policies ('Filter-Id', 'Reply-Message', 'Airespace-ACL-Name' or 'Aruba-User-Role'). Access points must receive this attribute in the RADIUS Access-Accept message.

options.name: radiusAuthenticationNasId
options.description: The template of the NAS identifier to be used for RADIUS authentication (ex. $NODE_MAC$ $VAP_NUM$).

options.name: radiusCalledStationId
options.description: The template of the called station identifier to be used for RADIUS (ex. $NODE_MAC$ $VAP_NUM$).

options.name: radiusCoaEnabled
options.description: If true, Meraki devices will act as a RADIUS Dynamic Authorization Server and will respond to RADIUS Change-of-Authorization and Disconnect messages sent by the RADIUS server.

options.name: radiusFailoverPolicy
options.description: This policy determines how authentication requests should be handled in the event that all of the configured RADIUS servers are unreachable ('Deny access' or 'Allow access').

options.name: radiusFallbackEnabled
options.description: Whether or not higher priority RADIUS servers should be retried after 60 seconds.

options.name: radiusGuestVlanEnabled
options.description: Whether or not RADIUS Guest VLAN is enabled. This param is only valid if the authMode is 'open-with-radius' and addressing mode is not set to 'isolated' or 'nat' mode.

options.name: radiusGuestVlanId
options.description: VLAN ID of the RADIUS Guest VLAN. This param is only valid if the authMode is 'open-with-radius' and addressing mode is not set to 'isolated' or 'nat' mode.

options.name: radiusLoadBalancingPolicy
options.description: This policy determines which RADIUS server will be contacted first in an authentication attempt and the ordering of any necessary retry attempts ('Strict priority order' or 'Round robin').

options.name: radiusOverride
options.description: If true, the RADIUS response can override VLAN tag. This is not valid when ipAssignmentMode is 'NAT mode'.

options.name: radiusProxyEnabled
options.description: If true, Meraki devices will proxy RADIUS messages through the Meraki cloud to the configured RADIUS auth and accounting servers.

options.name: radiusRadsec
options.description: The current settings for RADIUS RADSec.

options.name: radiusServerAttemptsLimit
options.description: The maximum number of transmit attempts after which a RADIUS server is failed over (must be between 1-5).

options.name: radiusServerTimeout
options.description: The amount of time for which a RADIUS client waits for a reply from the RADIUS server (must be between 1-10 seconds).

options.name: radiusServers
options.description: The RADIUS 802.1X servers to be used for authentication. This param is only valid if the authMode is 'open-with-radius', '8021x-radius' or 'ipsk-with-radius'.

options.name: radiusTestingEnabled
options.description: If true, Meraki devices will periodically send Access-Request messages to configured RADIUS servers using identity 'meraki_8021x_test' to ensure that the RADIUS servers are reachable.

options.name: secondaryConcentratorNetworkId
options.description: The secondary concentrator to use when the ipAssignmentMode is 'VPN'. If configured, the APs will switch to using this concentrator if the primary concentrator is unreachable. This param is optional. ('disabled' represents no secondary concentrator.).

options.name: speedBurst
options.description: The SpeedBurst setting for this SSID'.

options.name: splashGuestSponsorDomains
options.description: Array of valid sponsor email domains for sponsored guest splash type.

options.name: splashPage
options.description: The type of splash page for the SSID ('None', 'Click-through splash page', 'Billing', 'Password-protected with Meraki RADIUS', 'Password-protected with custom RADIUS', 'Password-protected with Active Directory', 'Password-protected with LDAP', 'SMS authentication', 'Systems Manager Sentry', 'Facebook Wi-Fi', 'Google OAuth', 'Microsoft Entra ID', 'Sponsored guest', 'Cisco ISE' or 'Google Apps domain').This attribute is not supported for template children.

options.name: ssidAdminAccessible
options.description: SSID Administrator access status.

options.name: useVlanTagging
options.description: Whether or not traffic should be directed to use specific VLANs. This param is only valid if the ipAssignmentMode is 'Bridge mode' or 'Layer 3 roaming'.

options.name: visible
options.description: Boolean indicating whether APs should advertise or hide this SSID. APs will only broadcast this SSID if set to true.

options.name: vlanId
options.description: The VLAN ID used for VLAN tagging. This param is only valid when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Layer 3 roaming with a concentrator' or 'VPN'.

options.name: walledGardenEnabled
options.description: Allow access to a configurable list of IP ranges, which users may access prior to sign-on.

options.name: walledGardenRanges
options.description: Specify your walled garden by entering an array of addresses, ranges using CIDR notation, domain names, and domain wildcards (e.g. '192.168.1.1/24', '192.168.37.10/32', 'www.yahoo.com', '*.google.com'). Meraki's splash page is automatically included in your walled garden.

options.name: wpaEncryptionMode
options.description: The types of WPA encryption. ('WPA1 only', 'WPA1 and WPA2', 'WPA2 only', 'WPA3 Transition Mode', 'WPA3 only' or 'WPA3 192-bit Security').
